questions.q: Surha Tal, declared India's 100th Ramsar site in June 2026, is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.explain: Surha Tal in Ballia became India's 100th Ramsar site (a wetland of international importance under the Ramsar Convention); Uttar Pradesh (UP) then had 13 such sites.

questions.q: India signed a $629 million deal in June 2026 to export BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles to which country?
questions.explain: The $629 million BrahMos export deal was signed with Vietnam; BrahMos is an India–Russia joint venture missile.

questions.q: Who took over as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) on 30 June 2026?
questions.explain: General Dhiraj Seth became the 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) on 30 June 2026; General Anil Chauhan is the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS).

questions.q: Who won the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 title?
questions.explain: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) beat Gujarat Titans by 5 wickets in the final to win their second consecutive Indian Premier League (IPL) title.

questions.q: Who became the first Indian to win the Norway Chess title in 2026?
questions.explain: R. Praggnanandhaa became the first Indian to win Norway Chess, one of the world's strongest chess tournaments.

questions.q: Which state became the 36th State/Union Territory to join Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)?
questions.explain: West Bengal joined Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY), which provides ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year.

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme, which completed six years on 1 June 2026, provides collateral-free loans to ___
questions.explain: The Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) gives street vendors collateral-free loans in tranches of ₹10,000, ₹20,000 and ₹50,000.

questions.q: The revised Index of Industrial Production (IIP) series released in June 2026 uses which base year?
questions.explain: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) revised the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) base year to 2022–23.

questions.q: India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth rate for the financial year 2025–26 was ___
questions.explain: India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 6.5% in the financial year 2025–26.

questions.q: Which country hosted the Group of Seven (G7) Summit attended by Prime Minister Modi in June 2026?
questions.explain: France hosted the Group of Seven (G7) Summit in June 2026, which Prime Minister (PM) Modi attended.

questions.q: In June 2026, which country became the ninth country where India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is accepted?
questions.explain: Cambodia became the ninth country accepting the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), India's instant payment system.

questions.q: According to the Global Peace Index 2026, which country is the most peaceful in the world?
questions.explain: Iceland topped the Global Peace Index 2026; India ranked 127th.

questions.q: The Kavach train safety system upgrade approved in June 2026 is called ___
questions.explain: Kavach 4.0, India's automatic train protection system, was approved for expansion across more railway sections.

questions.q: India's first satellite-based aircraft landing (at Udaipur airport) used which system?
questions.explain: The landing used GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation (GAGAN), India's satellite-based augmentation system, on an IndiGo Airbus A320.

questions.q: Microsoft unveiled which quantum computing chip in June 2026?
questions.explain: Microsoft unveiled the Majorana 2 quantum chip, built for more stable qubits.

questions.q: Who became the first footballer to receive the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports?
questions.explain: Lionel Messi became the first footballer to receive Spain's Princess of Asturias Award for Sports.

questions.q: Jainendra K. Jain, an Indian-American physicist, won which prestigious prize in 2026?
questions.explain: Jainendra K. Jain won the Wolf Prize in Physics 2026 for work on composite fermions.

questions.q: National Statistics Day is observed on 29 June to mark the birth anniversary of ___
questions.explain: National Statistics Day (29 June) marks the birth anniversary of Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis, founder of the Indian Statistical Institute.

questions.q: Who took oath as the 24th Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026?
questions.explain: D. K. Shivakumar became the 24th Chief Minister (CM) of Karnataka on 3 June 2026.

questions.q: India and which country signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) in June 2026?
questions.explain: India signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with Oman in June 2026.

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at the French Open 2026?
questions.explain: Alexander Zverev won the French Open 2026 men's singles title at Roland Garros, Paris.

questions.q: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won the men's doubles title at which 2026 tournament?
questions.explain: The pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won the Singapore Open men's doubles title in June 2026.

questions.q: Sarvam AI, which became India's 130th unicorn in June 2026, works in which field?
questions.explain: Sarvam AI, an artificial intelligence (AI) company building Indian-language models, became India's 130th unicorn (a startup valued over $1 billion).

questions.q: According to the Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2026, India's rank in number of unicorns is ___
questions.explain: India ranked 4th in the Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2026 with 61 unicorns.

questions.q: The world's first facility producing hydrogen using nuclear process heat was inaugurated in June 2026 at ___
questions.explain: The facility at Kalpakkam (Tamil Nadu) uses nuclear process heat to produce hydrogen — a world first.

questions.q: 'Mission Sana', launched in June 2026, relates to ___
options: India's first indigenous super pressure balloon
questions.explain: Mission Sana is India's first indigenous super pressure balloon for long-duration atmospheric research.

questions.q: Which Indian state got its first fully solar-powered border outpost, set up by the Border Security Force (BSF) in June 2026?
questions.explain: The Border Security Force (BSF) set up its first fully solar-powered border outpost in Gujarat.

questions.q: The new Producer Price Index (PPI) and revised Wholesale Price Index (WPI) series launched on 15 June 2026 use which base year?
questions.explain: Both the Producer Price Index (PPI) and the revised Wholesale Price Index (WPI) series use base year 2022–23.

questions.q: India won which football championship in June 2026, defeating the Maldives in the final?
options: South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) Women's Championship
questions.explain: India won the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) Women's Championship 2026.

questions.q: Who won the Orange Cap (most runs) in the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026?
questions.explain: Young batter Vaibhav Suryavanshi won the Orange Cap in the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026.

questions.q: The joint military exercise 'Shakti' is held between India and which country?
questions.explain: Exercise Shakti is the India–France joint military exercise; the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) also tested a laser-based counter-drone system in June 2026.

questions.q: Which Indian cricketer was named Player of the Match in the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 final?
questions.explain: Virat Kohli was Player of the Match in the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 final.

questions.q: The Zojila Tunnel, whose breakthrough was scheduled in June 2026, connects Srinagar with ___
questions.explain: The Zojila Tunnel (about 13 km) will give all-weather connectivity between Srinagar and Leh in Ladakh.

questions.q: Which organisation signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Health Authority in June 2026 for Ayushman Bharat digital health integration in West Bengal?
questions.explain: The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed with the Government of West Bengal as the state joined the National Health Authority's digital health ecosystem.

questions.q: The indigenous human papillomavirus (HPV) test kit validated in June 2026 is used for screening which cancer?
questions.explain: The human papillomavirus (HPV) test kit screens for cervical cancer, which is linked to HPV infection.

questions.q: Who became the 48th Vice Chief of the Naval Staff (VCNS) in June 2026?
questions.explain: Vice Admiral Ajay Kochhar became the 48th Vice Chief of the Naval Staff (VCNS) in June 2026.

questions.q: The first commercial electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) air taxi trial in India was conducted in which state?
questions.explain: Andhra Pradesh hosted India's first commercial electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) air taxi trial in June 2026.

questions.q: India signed an agreement in June 2026 to co-develop jet engines with which country?
questions.explain: India and France agreed to co-develop advanced jet engines in June 2026.

questions.q: The book 'The Emergency Files' released in June 2026 is associated with which period of Indian history?
questions.explain: 'The Emergency Files' documents the Emergency of 1975–77, a frequently asked topic in Indian polity and history.

questions.q: Which Indian city hosted the 2026 Commonwealth Games (CWG) preparatory 'King's Baton Relay' event in India in June 2026?
questions.explain: Ahmedabad, the host city of the 2030 Commonwealth Games (CWG), received the King's Baton Relay in June 2026.
